summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of mask propagation in NDDataRef arithmetic operations, but it may introduce behavioral regressions and lacks comprehensive tests.

issues.description: The patch changes the condition to check if `operand.mask` is None instead of `operand` being None. This could lead to unexpected behavior if `operand` is an instance of NDDataRef without a mask attribute.
The patch does not include additional tests to verify the correctness of the mask propagation logic in various scenarios, including different types of operands and combinations of masks.
